title: Subjectifying the Personality State: Theoretical Underpinnings and an Empirical Example
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, group-level within-person network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample was limited in size and number of assessments per participant; - Reliability estimates for the MSMQ modes were moderate at best; - The analytic approach is still a work in progress; - The sampling rate may have masked instantaneous dynamics between modes.
notes: The paper was not preregistered, but the authors declared that the data and materials are openly available on OSF. The code for the network analyses is also available on OSF. The sample was a community sample of well-adjusted participants, which may limit generalizability to clinical populations.
